ops.sql: SELECT Package_ID, Name, ea_guid, Parent_ID FROM t_package WHERE Package_ID IN (685, 686, 377, 380) ORDER BY Package_ID
SELECT Object_ID, Name, ea_guid, Object_Type, Package_ID FROM t_object WHERE Object_ID IN (1966, 1967, 2040, 2055, 2079, 2080, 2081) ORDER BY Object_ID
SELECT Object_ID, Name, ea_guid, Stereotype, Package_ID FROM t_object WHERE Name = 'AICodeBridge' AND Stereotype = 'JavascriptAddin'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_operation WHERE Object_ID IN (SELECT Object_ID FROM t_object WHERE Name = 'AICodeBridge' AND Stereotype = 'JavascriptAddin')
SELECT Name, StyleEx FROM t_operation WHERE Object_ID IN (SELECT Object_ID FROM t_object WHERE Name = 'AICodeBridge' AND Stereotype = 'JavascriptAddin') AND Name LIKE 'EA_%' ORDER BY Name
SELECT GroupID, GroupName FROM t_secgroup ORDER BY GroupName
